title: PresenceCacheResource.max_entries not validated
description: In python/src/lichen/coap/resources/presence.py, PresenceCacheResource.__init__ (lines 238-242) accepts max_entries without validation. If max_entries <= 0 or is not an integer, _enforce_max() would immediately evict all entries on every record() call (the condition 'len(self._nodes) <= self._max_entries' would always be false). Compare with MessagesResource.__init__ in messaging.py which validates max_messages with 'if isinstance(max_messages, bool) or not isinstance(max_messages, int) or max_messages <= 0: raise ValueError'. Fix: add the same validation at the start of PresenceCacheResource.__init__.
